summary.description: An evidence-driven Fixer variant for caller-scoped codebase cleanup and bounded maintenance debt.

overrides.description: Evidence-backed cleanup that removes confirmed maintenance waste without scope drift.

delegation.when: The task is a caller-scoped cleanup that can be justified by reference evidence and does not require feature, redesign, upgrade, or security-review work.

routing.description: Use for evidence-backed, bounded cleanup after the caller has identified the maintenance scope.

summary.description: A bounded Fixer variant for executing well-scoped, already-decided code changes without architectural drift.

overrides.description: Fast bounded implementation after the work has been scoped and decided.

delegation.when: The desired code change is explicit, bounded, and does not require design taste, fresh research, or a new architecture.

routing.description: Use after discovery and decisions are complete for a bounded implementation task.

summary.description: A disciplined Explorer variant for quickly mapping unfamiliar repositories before deeper work begins.

overrides.description: Fast, evidence-first repository mapping for deepwork investigations.

delegation.when: The task needs broad, fast, read-only discovery across several folders or the request names concepts rather than paths.

routing.description: Use before planning when the codebase, ownership, or relevant files are unclear.

summary.description: An Oracle-derived profile for independent risk review, root-cause analysis, and simplification pressure.

overrides.description: Independent architecture and correctness review for uncertain or high-risk changes.

delegation.when: A change is high-risk, has survived repeated failed fixes, crosses system boundaries, or needs independent YAGNI scrutiny.

routing.description: Escalate to this profile when correctness or long-term maintainability risk is materially uncertain.

summary.description: A Librarian-derived profile for authoritative documentation and version-specific implementation research.

overrides.description: Version-aware external research with primary-source evidence.

delegation.when: The answer depends on current or version-specific library documentation, official examples, or an unfamiliar external system.

routing.description: Use when a library API, release behavior, or external convention must be verified before coding.

summary.description: A Designer-derived profile for auditing user-facing interaction quality and visual intent before release.

overrides.description: High-signal UI/UX critique and implementation for intentional interface polish.

delegation.when: The task's quality depends on layout, hierarchy, visual styling, interaction feel, responsive behavior, or a design-system decision.

routing.description: Use for user-facing UI polish, responsive behavior, interaction affordances, or visual consistency review.

summary.description: An Oracle-derived agent for evidence-backed application, dependency, configuration, and trust-boundary security review.

overrides.description: Evidence-backed security review focused on credible exploit paths and minimal remediation.

delegation.when: A scoped change or system needs an independent security review grounded in concrete code, configuration, resolved dependency, or advisory evidence.

routing.description: Use for focused, evidence-backed review of exploitable security risks in application behavior, dependencies, configuration, and trust boundaries.

summary.description: An Observer-derived profile for extracting exact, structured facts from screenshots, PDFs, and diagrams.

overrides.description: Exact, concise visual analysis for screenshots, PDFs, and diagrams.

delegation.when: The task requires reading or comparing screenshots, images, PDFs, diagrams, or other visual media rather than plain text.

routing.description: Use to isolate large visual or media inputs and return concise structured observations.
